text:
Senator Pete Ricketts discusses tax policy, housing legislation, and community initiatives
Senator Pete Ricketts, representing Nebraska, recently shared updates on his activities and legislative priorities through a series of posts on social media. The posts highlighted his engagement with local business owners, support for housing legislation, and recognition of community service organizations.
On August 17, 2026, Senator Ricketts posted about a meeting with local entrepreneurs: "Enjoyed sharing lunch with Nebraska small business owners at Don Carmelo’s in Eklhorn. We had a productive conversation about how I’m working on their behalf in the Senate. This includes with 20% Small Business Tax Deduction. This was made possible with the Working Families Tax https://t.co/eKz3JK8For".
The following day, August 18, he discussed recent legislative progress regarding housing: "Earlier this year, @SenateGOP passed the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act. It’s the most significant housing bill in over three decades. The bill cuts red tape, speeds up permitting, and helps get more homes built for Nebraska families. We are making housing more affordable. https://t.co/EeheGMiD47".
On August 19, Senator Ricketts highlighted a longstanding community resource: "Since 1982, the Gathering Place has been a place for everyone in Lincoln to have a warm meal and a seat at the table. This is a great example of neighbors taking care of neighbors. https://t.co/BcJ9ddDq41".
Senator Ricketts provides assistance to Nebraskans with federal agencies and engages in community leadership roles through various boards such as the Mid-America Council of the Boy Scouts and Opportunity Education Foundation (source). He grew up in Nebraska City and Omaha in a family led by an entrepreneur father and teacher mother and currently resides in Omaha with his wife and three children. His educational background includes graduating from Westside High School and earning degrees from the University of Chicago. In addition to public service, he has served on boards for TD Ameritrade and the Chicago Cubs.
